text_block_list.text:
The day of the Champions Cup. Chukyo 
Racecourse, also hosting popular turf 
races, recorded near-capacity attendance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Returning to her initial motivation of 
wanting to "shine," Smart Falcon looks 
nervous. Her Trainer tells her, "You'll be 
fine."

Falcon stepped up to the race.
